about: OPTIMAL CONNECTIVITY builds technical solutions with products from HARTING, one of the world’s leading manufacturers of industrial connectivity. The primary focus of OPTIMAL CONNECTIVITY activities is into Energy, eMobility, Transportation, Machinery, Robotics, Automation and Industry 4.0.

OPTIMAL CONNECTIVITY has been awarded by Kathrein Solutions as System Partner and Reseller. Kathrein’s products focus on RFID technologies. Based on products manufactured by Kathrein Solutions, we are offering turnkey AutoID solutions including hardware, software, services and support. RFID applications are for Oil & Gas, Chemical Industry, Logistics, Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Vehicle Identification, etc.
